candidates.title: Prepare invoice fields for billing review

demandEvidence.chore: Manage finances and time reporting, including invoicing, customer follow-up and KPI reporting.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: Hantera ekonomi och tidsrapportera– sköta fakturering, följa upp kunder och rapportera nyckeltal till ägaren

ease.reason: The template extracts invoice fields and logs them, offering a concrete starting pattern; adapting it still needs test documents and setup.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: professional offices may value quicker billing preparation; this notice does not establish demand for an AI service.

feasibility.reason: A two-week mock can extract a few operator-chosen fields from synthetic invoices, but source rules and accuracy are unknown.

autonomy.reason: Extraction and logging can repeat, while a person must verify every field and approve billing or customer follow-up.

evidence.reason: The notice names invoicing; the n8n listing describes invoice extraction and logging, but neither proves this proposed version works.

candidates.reason: Concrete invoice task with a relevant template reference, but the bounded proposal averages 5.2, below the threshold of 6; no post.

candidates.title: Build a document filing index

demandEvidence.chore: Register, diarize and archive records and documents.

ease.reason: A fictional index can be made with a spreadsheet, but the notice supplies no file formats or classification rules.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: professional offices may value filing assistance; this notice does not establish AI-service demand.

feasibility.reason: A mock can index operator-supplied fictional documents, but required fields and retention rules are unspecified.

autonomy.reason: A draft index is repeatable; a person must verify categories and handle official records and retention decisions.

evidence.reason: The notice explicitly names registration, diarization and archiving, but gives no workflow detail or implementation reference.

candidates.reason: The literal filing tasks are concrete, but no attached building reference supports mechanics; this proposal averages 4.2 and is below threshold.

rejected.title: Broad administrator and creative communications role
rejected.reason: The privacy-safe notice describes a broad administrative and creative communications role but identifies no concrete chore to design around; the vacancy excerpt does not support inventing duties.

rejected.title: Paid administrator role with no task excerpt
rejected.reason: The fresh notice excerpt contains no concrete task, so a specific experiment or demand quote cannot be grounded.

rejected.reason: The excerpt names booking-system handling and customer support but no bounded task; support triage overlaps recent support-inbox posts (98b4f6281cc3de4ecdfa95f6 and e20bcacf021524725d3fc275).

steps.message: Assessed all five selected demand leads. The concrete invoice and filing proposals are below threshold; the other three lack a sufficiently bounded distinct task. No post proposed.
